learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn when to use the three special pointing words A, An, and The!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We use A before words that start with a consonant sound. We say a cat and a ball.
We use An before words that start with a magic vowel sound A E I O U. We say an apple and an umbrella.
We use The when we talk about a specific or very special thing. The Sun is bright and The sky is blue.

fun_activity.title: 🎯 A or An Game
fun_activity.instructions: Write five words on paper like egg bat ant dog and owl. Put A or An correctly in front of each word!

quick_recap: ⭐ The is used for special or specific things.
